outcome: Resolution of local inflammation and peritonitis
Local infection control of septic focus
cohort: A single patient who experienced peritonitis and sepsis due to an early rupture of a uterine suture after a third caesarean section.
finding: The application of IU-NPT combined with A-NPWT successfully achieved local infection control, resolved peritonitis, facilitated closure of a uterine defect, and avoided a hysterectomy in a patient with severe post-caesarean section complications.
mod_finding: IU-NPT was successfully used to treat severe complications, including peritonitis and a uterine suture rupture, which occurred after a third caesarean section, thereby preventing a hysterectomy.
followup_time: The patient was discharged four days after the end of IU-NPT (which lasted 11 days), following an initial laparotomy on the 15th day after caesarean section.
